**Observation Log:**

- [PREFERENCE] User is trying to reduce their carbon footprint and is looking for eco-friendly product recommendations.

- [PREFERENCE] User prefers a subtle look that won't show fingerprints or stains easily.

- [PREFERENCE] User is curious about eco-friendly cleaning products and is looking for a good all-purpose cleaner that is non-toxic and biodegradable.
